mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above a 0.3pp monthly threshold signals deteriorating labor market conditions and potential economic slowdown, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of months when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their respective 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.5% from prior month, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO falling below its 3-month moving average), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of months when INDPRO falls > 0.5% from prior month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with positive equity market sentiment and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months when HOUST is above its 6-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above a 0.5pp monthly threshold signals rising inflation, which may prompt monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of months when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.3% and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months when PAYEMS rises > 0.3% and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand (as indicated by both RSAFS and HOUST above their 6-month moving averages), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns as investors anticipate sustained economic growth.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both above 6-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months when both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 6-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.
